chunks: Abū al-Ward asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a Christian slave belonging to a Muslim man: “Is jizyah due upon him?” He said:
“Yes.” He said: “Then should his Muslim master pay the jizyah on his behalf?” He said: “Yes. He is only his property; he ransoms him if he is taken, paying on his behalf.”

key_terms.جِزْيَةٌ: poll tax levied in this legal context

ai.seo_question: Does a Muslim master pay the jizyah for his Christian slave?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a Christian slave owned by a Muslim. It states that jizyah applies to him, and that his Muslim master pays it on his behalf, since the slave is counted among his property and is redeemed by him if seized.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.1679 - Abu Al-Ward asked Abu Ja’far (as) about a Christian slave owned by a Muslim man:
"Is jizya required of him?"
Imam (as) replied: "Yes."

He then asked: "Should the Muslim master pay the jizya on his behalf?"
Imam (as) replied: "Yes, it is his wealth; he ransoms him by paying on his behalf if he is taken."
